cq_coverage.1: CQ1 (What invoices are all listed in an EDIFACT message?) is answered by the InterchangeEnvelope class and containsMessage property, which links the envelope to Message and specifically to InvoiceMessage.
cq_coverage.2: CQ2 (Which organizations are involved in the invoice?) is addressed by the OrganizationRoleAssignment pivot class, which relates InvoiceMessage to Organizations via organizationRoleAssignment and involvesOrganization properties.
cq_coverage.3: CQ3 (What role does organization S play in the invoice?) is modeled by the OrganizationRoleAssignment class and organizationRole property, relating an Organization to its AgentRole in the context of an InvoiceMessage.
cq_coverage.4: CQ4 (Which organization is the buyer in the invoice?) is similarly addressed by filtering OrganizationRoleAssignment for AgentRole=Buyer.
cq_coverage.5: CQ5 (What information is displayed about the involved organizations?) is covered by the hasAddress, hasIdentifier, and organizationRoleAssignment properties, linking Organization to Address/Identifier and contextual roles.
cq_coverage.6: CQ6 (What is the address of the buyer?) is answered by following organizationRoleAssignment (with AgentRole=Buyer) to Organization, then hasAddress to Address.
cq_coverage.7: CQ7 (What items are sold in the invoice?) is modeled by listsLineItem (DetailSection to LineItem) and describesItem (LineItem to Item).
cq_coverage.8: CQ8 (What information is displayed about the items sold?) is covered by describesItem, hasNetPrice, and hasQuantity properties on LineItem and Item.
cq_coverage.9: CQ9 (What is the net price of the items sold in the invoice?) is answered by hasNetPrice on LineItem.
cq_coverage.10: CQ10 (What are the invoice details of the invoice?) is addressed by the hasHeaderSection, hasDetailSection, and hasSummarySection properties on InvoiceMessage.
cq_coverage.11: CQ11 (What is the invoice amount of the invoice?) is modeled by hasInvoiceAmount on SummarySection.
cq_coverage.12: CQ12 (What is the invoice number?) is modeled by hasInvoiceNumber on InvoiceMessage.
cq_coverage.13: CQ13 (What information must be provided so that the file format is valid?) is addressed by hasIdentifier and identifierValue on Organization/Identifier, and by modeling the structural requirements of the EDIFACT message.
cq_coverage.14: CQ14 (To which business process can the invoice be assigned?) is answered by hasBusinessProcess linking InvoiceMessage to BusinessProcess.
